essence: Long fights cost more than any prize. Keep them short and use what you find.
modern_lens: Chapter 2 is about the hidden bill for prolonged effort: attention, money, morale and goodwill wear down while you wait for a result. Drawn-out disputes, failing projects and stalled negotiations charge the same bill. The chapter also advises winning with what the situation already offers, rather than hauling every resource in from home.

principles.name: Count the True Cost
principles.gloss: Price a conflict in time, money, morale and goodwill before you commit. The visible bill is only part of the total.

principles.name: Do Not Reinforce Losses
principles.gloss: Do not keep pouring resources into a failing effort. A second round of investment needs a new reason, not just momentum.

principles.name: Speed Over Stubbornness
principles.gloss: A quick, decisive resolution beats a long campaign. Delay drains the people who depend on the outcome.

principles.name: Use the Other Side's Resources
principles.gloss: Where you can, turn what the other party already provides into your own advantage, ethically and within the rules.
